study: AI multi-agent label and judgment study v0.1

roles.C: blind AI rater first; adjudicator only after all submissions frozen

blinding: Fresh agents without conversation history; opaque role-specific IDs and independently shuffled item order; workflow isolation on a shared filesystem, not an access-control sandbox. Original text and domain retained.
threshold: Report relationship to 0.70 descriptively; AI agreement does not satisfy human G1.
adjudication: C reviews union of nonunanimous binary labels, any rater ambiguity flags, and 20 preselected controls; freeze initial C labels first. Retain all original labels and unresolved outcomes.
model_diversity: Agents inherit the same configured model; same-model correlation is a limitation. Exact service model revision is not independently pinned.
prohibited: Prior AI result use by raters
